messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGER: autoscaler failed to provision GPUs in gcp-europe-west3. Pods pending due to quota errors. 80 jobs queued on inference-service/prod-llm (queue growth observed). Trigger: autoscaler health check 5xx.

Tess_oncall: Seeing the same in the console — pods stuck in Pending with `Forbidden: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded`. Can someone confirm which quota is hit?

maya_sre: I'm on it. Pulling the pod describe + events now. Suspect regional GPU quota for our service account/project.

raj_infra: Confirmed from GKE node pool events: `Compute Engine quota 'GPUS_ALL_REGIONS' or 'GPUS' in europe-west3` returned 403 with message about regional limit. Also a couple of failed instance creations with `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`.

alyssa_support: Customer impact — two high-volume tenants on dedicated pools report elevated tail latency; support ticket #INC-4532 linked. We should triage impact and message customers if this will be >30m.

omar_product: Which customers exactly? Need to know if SLA will be affected. I can draft a short status note for customers once we have ETA.

maya_sre: Quick mitigation options: 1) failover affected traffic to eu-west1 where we have spare GPU capacity, 2) reduce min replicas / pause low-priority batch jobs, 3) request quota increase from GCP (slow), 4) temporarily lower per-pod GPU request (not ideal).

Tess_oncall: Start with 1+2. Raj, can you open a temporary routing rule to shift new sessions to eu-west1? Prefer transparent fallback via routing policy so running sessions aren't interrupted.

raj_infra: Working on routing change. Pushing a canary policy to route 70% new requests for prod-llm to eu-west1. Command I ran: 
```bash
# internal routing tool
redwood-router apply --service prod-llm --policy fallback-eu-west1 --weight 70
```
I'll monitor token-level errors.

eng-pager-bot: :white_check_mark: Routing update applied. 70% of new requests now routed to eu-west1.

maya_sre: While routing shifts, I'm scaling down low-priority batch queue consumers to free up slots in europe-west3. Command: 
```bash
kubectl scale deploy batch-consumer --replicas=1 -n infra --context=prod-europe-west3
```
This should free ~8 GPUs.

alyssa_support: Notified affected customers (tenants A and C) on the ticket with a short note: "We are routing new requests to an alternate region to reduce errors; you may see slightly higher latency for a short period. Will update in 30 minutes."

Tess_oncall: Good. Meanwhile, try a quick capacity check with GCP console: what exact quota name do we request an increase for?

raj_infra: From the error payload: `projects/rdw-prod/regions/europe-west3/quotas: GPUS (NVIDIA_T4)` and fallback showed `GPUS_PREEMPTIBLE` also near limit. I initiated a quota request via Cloud Console to increase regional GPU quota by +20. Request ID: QREQ-99871.

cloud-gcp: (on-call at GCP) Noted — quota request queued. Typical approval time is a few hours unless you add justification and increase via sales support. If urgent, open a support case with priority.

maya_sre: I'll open a paid support case now and ping the GCP escalation channel.

raj_infra: After the routing change and scaling down batch consumers, queue length decreased from 80 -> 22 in ~8 minutes. Errors for new requests dropped from 15% -> 2%.

Tess_oncall: Nice. Any failures remaining for existing in-flight jobs?

maya_sre: A handful (~6) of pods still Pending due to quota reservations; they will either time out or get rescheduled to eu-west1 depending on the scheduler. We're not force-evicting running pods.

omar_product: For customer comms: please include the mitigation steps and ETA for full recovery. ETA is contingent on GCP quota approval; can we give an ETA window?

alyssa_support: Given progress, initial ETA: 1–3 hours for full normalization if quota increase approved; otherwise 6+ hours if we rely solely on rerouting and gradual backfill.

Tess_oncall: OK. I'll update the incident channel and tag infra-leads. Action items: raj - monitor routing and node pool creation (owner), maya - follow GCP support case (owner), alyssa - keep customers updated (owner), omar - draft postmortem template.

raj_infra: Logging monitoring query used: 
```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM autoscaler_events WHERE region='europe-west3' AND reason='QUOTA_EXCEEDED' SINCE 1h
```
I'll attach graphs to the ticket.

eng-pager-bot: :pager: Pager acknowledged by tess_oncall.

cloud-gcp: GCP support case update: we've routed your quota increase to regional team for expedited review; they asked for usage justification and expected sustained usage — I replied with traffic graphs and customer counts. Will update in ~30m.

maya_sre: Quick note for infra: add temporary guardrail to prevent autoscaler from launching more than 5 parallel node provisioning attempts per minute; we saw spike that triggered provider-side throttling. File: infra/ops/autoscaler-rate-limits.

Tess_oncall: Good catch. Also reduce default pod GPU request for low-priority queues from 1 to 0.5 GPU (fractional via multi-gpu-scheduling) where safe. Raj, coordinate with schedulers.

raj_infra: A/B tested fractional GPU scheduling — seems okay for batch jobs. Implemented for low-priority queue. Monitoring.

alyssa_support: Customer update posted: "We've routed new requests to an alternate region and reduced batch processing to stabilize capacity. We're continuing to work with GCP for quota increase. Will notify when normal performance resumes." Customers appreciated the proactive update.

cloud-gcp: Update: Support case advanced — regional quota team requested a 1-hour window to evaluate. If you can accept temporary elevated usage, they may approve faster.

maya_sre: We gave justification and said it's bursty but sustained at peak; asked for +30 GPUs for 24h as a bridge.

raj_infra: Current status: errors now <1%, queue ~6. New pod creations are succeeding in eu-west1; europe-west3 still constrained.

Tess_oncall: I'll keep the channel open. If we hit errors >3% again, escalate to on-call SRE lead.

eng-pager-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident acknowledged as MITIGATED (user-visible impact reduced) — will keep as high-priority until quota change confirmed.

cloud-gcp: Final update: quota increase approved (+25 GPUs) for europe-west3 for your project. Change should reflect in ~10 minutes; opening case closed.

maya_sre: Confirmed in console — new node requests succeed and Pending pods are scheduling. Rolling back routing weights to normal over next 5 minutes.

raj_infra: Routing set back to 100% europe-west3 for prod-llm. Command: `redwood-router apply --service prod-llm --policy default --weight 100`. Batch consumers scaled back up.

alyssa_support: Sent customers final update: "Issue resolved; normal routing restored. We will follow up with a postmortem and prevention steps."

omar_product: Thanks team. Please add postmortem items: permanent quota increase or autoscaler guardrails, improved monitoring alerts (quota burn-rate), and runbook updates for cross-region fallback. I'll own the follow-up.

Tess_oncall: Post-incident actions:
- maya: write support case transcript and attach to incident (done)
- raj: add autoscaler rate-limit guardrail and run deploy (todo)
- omar: postmortem draft (todo)
- alyssa: ensure customers get PM follow-up (todo)

maya_sre: I'll capture logs and timeline into the incident tracker and close the ticket when the postmortem is posted.

eng-pager-bot: Incident closed by tess_oncall at 1715127200.
